name: pinme
tagline_zh: 说句“pinme”就把文件钉上IPFS，顺手把网站、API、数据库全部署好——连邮件都替你发，后端苦力全包。
tagline_en: Say 'pinme' to pin files to IPFS, then deploy sites, APIs, DBs, and emails—your full-stack backend errand boy.
desc_en: Use this skill when the user mentions "pinme", or needs to upload files, store to IPFS, create/publish/deploy websites or full-stack services (including frontend pages, backend APIs, database storage, email sending, etc.), or any feature requiring backend database/server support.
why_zh: 同类工具只管存文件，它却把部署、数据库、邮件串成一条链，一句话触发全流程。
why_en: Others just store files; this one chains deployment, DB, and email into one command—a full-stack trigger.
